name: Cleft
summary: Gnarlpine furbolgs ambush travelers in the Cleft, northwest of Dolanaar.

sections.title: A Den of Corruption
sections.body: The Cleft lies off the road between Dolanaar and Darnassus, where Gnarlpine furbolgs have made their den. Teldrassil’s spreading corruption has driven them mad, and they have fortified the hollow. From there, they threaten travelers on the main road and risk cutting Dolanaar off from Darnassus.

sections.title: The Roadway Ambushers
sections.body: Moon Priestess Amara and her sentinels keep watch outside the Cleft’s entrance. Their defense guards the main road linking Teldrassil’s villages with Darnassus, but the Gnarlpine still threaten its passage.

faq.answer: The Cleft is a furbolg den northwest of Dolanaar, beside the main road to Darnassus.
Hostile Gnarlpine furbolgs occupy the Cleft, driven mad by Teldrassil’s spreading corruption.

faq.q: Why are the night elves fighting here?
faq.answer: The Gnarlpine ambush travelers on the road to Darnassus, so Moon Priestess Amara and the Sentinels work to keep the road safe.

faq.q: Is the Cleft related to the Cleft of Shadow?
faq.answer: No. The Cleft is a furbolg cave in Teldrassil; the Cleft of Shadow is a dark cavern beneath Orgrimmar.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see longtime furbolg allies driven mad and attacking travelers.
As a druid, you know the corrupted Gnarlpine threaten travelers on the road to Darnassus.
